title: Physical Processes Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly explain the physical significance of the terms A ∇²ρ and B ρ, including why A and B are positive.

title: Critical Length Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the critical length L_0 correctly in terms of A and B, showing the relationship between neutron density and cube dimensions.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The response should correctly state and apply the boundary conditions for the neutron density at the surfaces of the cube.

title: Mathematical Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show clear mathematical steps in separating variables and solving the differential equation.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for L_0 must be presented clearly and correctly, including any necessary constants or factors.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the derivation or incorrect factors in the final answer.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms in the equations are dimensionally consistent and provide units where applicable.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The response may include alternative methods or reasoning to arrive at the same conclusion regarding L_0.
